The bytes paid (座位, and the colon after 唯一生产) change no meaning; bare 分诊 is how line 7 names the actor.
4. `filing-gate.md:26` — right. New line: 「- 缺件卡由分诊(单车道仓 `repo:*` 席)首触补齐卡与一次检索可推三件,写进定级评论并定级。」 The parenthetical names the single-lane first-touch actor beside 分诊, in the register line 25 uses (三件 is line 25's three answers); 「卡与一次检索可推三件」 keeps the same bound as 「能从卡与一次检索推导的三件」. Line 51 on `main` has no subject of its own, so in context it continued line 50 — it was correct about platform cards and silent about hotcrm's own, and the defect was that, read alone, it became a general reservation of `type`. B inherits line 50's subject the same way, so in place it would read as the hotcrm seat applying `type` to the platform card it has just filed — an objectstack or objectui card, where line 7 makes central triage the only producer. B would trade the old ambiguity for a new contradiction. A names both subjects, and each clause agrees with the line that governs it (7 for platform-repo cards, 10 for hotcrm's own). Ruling A, as the card records it, reaches the seat's own cards and no further, so the card's 〈What to change〉 for :51 is correctly read as scoped to those cards; the landed line is that reading, not a departure from the ruling. One observation, not required: 催办不代裁 now trails the 本仓卡 clause rather than the platform clause it qualifies; harmless, since on its own cards the seat is the one ruling, so the clause is vacuous there.
2. Deviation (the :51 wording refines the card's 〈What to change〉): accepted, for the reason in item 1.
3. Deviation (the family grep also hits `lanes/ui.md:8`): agreed, correct as written — 「⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级,中央分诊唯一生产」 is line 7 applied to the `domain:ui` seat, which works objectui, a multi-lane repo. Leaving it untouched is right.
4. Out-of-scope finding (`SKILL.md:113` `tooling` and `:118` `area:*` say 「分诊首触打」 with no repo-class scope): agreed, 承接者:无. Neither label is one of 机械三务 (line 10), so neither line contradicts ruling A; what remains is an absence (no named producer of `tooling` or `area:*` on a single-lane repo's cards), and `filing-gate.md:51` holds that an absent sentence is not what a card is for.
5. Deviation (attribution): verified on the head commit — its message ends with the session-URL trailer line and the model-free co-author trailer line, and the PR body ends with the session-URL footer; both are the forms AGENTS.md prescribes.
6. Deviations (history read through REST on a shallow checkout; worktree removed before the report; the relay run from the shared checkout's unchanged scripts): process notes, no effect on the landing.

Escalated to the landing seat as a check immediately before landing: if #24610 carries a `Ruling:` line by then, the card's instruction (fold its one line into the same PR) applies, the head moves, and this record no longer names it.

9. Adjacent, outside this ruling's family and not a card (`filing-gate.md:20`): `cross-repo-coordination.md:38` 「执行座位信任标签,只在本车道认领;误标 ⛔ 不自行改,挂 `pm:retriage` + 异议评论同笔。」 stays unscoped; for a single-lane seat that applied its own `type`, there is no triage to retriage to. It reserves neither `type` nor first touch for triage, so it is outside the card. 承接者:无; a seat-post note at most.
